report.title: Territory Native to Computation: Eviulon’s Geography, Borders, Jurisdiction, and Sovereign Continuity
report.summary: The advent of a sovereign state native entirely to computational space necessitates a fundamental reevaluation of geopolitical geography, public international law, and the mechanisms of state continuity. This exhaustive report provides an independent architectural, legal, and geographic framework…
